records.text: Son of Arugal is a recurring creature found in Silverpine Forest and Shadowfang Keep. It casts Arugal's Gift in combat.

Deathstalker Adamant was sent by High Executor Hadrec with Vincent to gather intelligence on Shadowfang Keep. A magical ward exposed the pair, and Adamant was imprisoned while Vincent fared worse. Once freed, Adamant helps open the courtyard door and plans to return to Hadrec with his report. He is focused on the mission and wary of the danger beyond the door.

Sorcerer Ashcrombe came from Dalaran at the Kirin Tor's direction to investigate Arugal's work with the undead in Silverpine Forest. Imprisoned in Shadowfang Keep, he escapes and uses magic to open the courtyard door before hurrying back to report to the Kirin Tor. He views the danger beyond the door cautiously and condemns one of its foes as scum.
Shadowfang Whitescalp is a beast found in the Shadowfang area. It casts Frost Armor while out of combat.
A Shadowfang Moonwalker whose combat skill includes an Anti-Magic Shield.
A Shadowfang Wolfguard that can summon a Wolfguard Worg while out of combat and use Dark Restore in battle.
A Shadowfang Darksoul that attacks with Befuddlement and Shadow Word: Pain.
A Shadowfang Glutton that uses Blood Tap in combat.
A Shadowfang Ragetooth that can enter a Wild Rage when badly hurt.
A lupine horror that summons Lupine Delusions in combat.
A fel steed that uses Fel Stomp when fighting.
A blood seeker that uses Expose Weakness in combat.
A deathsworn captain who takes Battle Stance outside combat and uses Cleave and Hamstring in a fight.
A tormented officer who uses Forsaken Skills in combat.
An undead servitor haunting the surrounding grounds, it calls on haunting spirits in battle.
An undead guardsman haunting the surrounding grounds, it unleashes screams of the past in battle.
Razorclaw the Butcher is a solitary beast in the surrounding grounds, known for draining foes in battle.
Baron Silverlaine is an undead baron who warns intruders away from this accursed place and wields shadow magic in combat.
Known as the Cell Keeper, Rethilgore is an undead jailer who drains souls in battle.
When speaking of his pack's destruction, Wolf Master Nandos expresses disbelief and promises wrath; in battle he summons lupine horrors and bleak worgs.
Fenrus the Devourer is a named beast who attacks with Toxic Saliva. His death also advances the encounter.
Archmage Arugal demands service and identifies his opponents as interfering with the Sons of Arugal. He calls out when one falls, portraying a hostile spellcaster who seeks to make others serve him.

Commander Springvale keeps eternal vigilance and warns that intruders are in the keep, calling for arms. In combat he uses Hammer of Justice and Holy Light, joining a defensive warning with holy magic.
Odo the Blindwatcher is a named humanoid who calls for help when attacked and uses Howling Rage as his health falls.

Deathstalker Vincent is one of two agents sent into Shadowfang to gather intelligence ahead of an assault. The quest's closing account describes him dead, with any additional information he gained lost; a small trinket remains in his hand.

Arugal was a Kirin Tor representative before turning against them. He commands loyal servants and his sons, threatens trespassers in his domain, and tries to make a prisoner serve his master. He holds the Kirin Tor remnants in contempt.
Sever is an undead creature that spits disease in combat and enters a frenzy as it is wounded.

Landen Stilwell speaks of recurring sickness that may take him again and asks others to leave him alone before it returns. His words convey a personal concern about the sickness, though they do not explain its cause.

Apothecary Hummel leads the Crown Chemical Co. and resists the subpoena delivered to him, dismissing the papers and insisting his work is nobody else's business. He alludes to an earlier Dragonblight misunderstanding and says the castle gives his company time to develop products. His own speech questions whether others understand why he is acting, then says it is time for this to end; he calls Baxter and Frye to fight and asks that people not think less of him. He also orders fellow apothecaries to give their lives for the Crown, presenting their struggle as service to it.
A Crown Apothecary is identified by affiliation and role rather than by an individual name.

Investigator Fezzen Brasstacks is working undercover on Apothecary Hummel’s operation in Shadowfang Keep. He has prepared the paperwork Snagglebolt requested and is waiting for backup to serve Hummel with a court subpoena. Fezzen also supplies a kit with neutralizers to help counter chemical tricks.

place_records.text: You are in Shadowfang Keep, a dungeon fortress in Silverpine Forest, reached from Pyrewood Village. Undead hold it under Archmage Arugal, who demands service and has his Sons of Arugal about him, with Rethilgore the Cell Keeper, an undead jailer, as the other master. Haunted servitors fill its halls, and Arugal still resides here. Deathstalkers sent to gather intelligence on the keep have not returned.
